tests.name: 5000/753轮回真实发生过强化、消耗和PP回复后回末还原选择快照，免弱不阻返回原等级
tests.assertion: test('5000/753轮回真实发生过强化、消耗和PP回复后回末还原选择快照，免弱不阻返回原等级',()=>{const s=make({move:25679,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:500}});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;const before={hp:100,pp:{...s.fighters[0].pp},stages:{...s.fighters[0].stages}},old=E.SOULS;let actualStages;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)actualStages={...c.a.stages};}};try{turn(s,25679,10127);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(actualStages.atk>0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.some(x=>x.before!==x.after));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,before.hp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].pp,before.pp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].stages,before.stages);});

tests.name: 5000/753轮回已1HP受正结算攻击与附固均保1而实际HP损失0，正伤害仍获虚无；自身出手受到真实816反伤不触发轮回
tests.assertion: test('5000/753轮回已1HP受正结算攻击与附固均保1而实际HP损失0，正伤害仍获虚无；自身出手受到真实816反伤不触发轮回',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{spe:500},enemySource:source,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[10994,10993,10996,20607,31143]});s.fighters[1].soulId=null;turn(s,20606,10994);const incoming=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.targetSide===0);assert.ok(incoming.some(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.settledDamage>0&&e.hpLoss===0));assert.ok(incoming.some(e=>e.type==='fixed'&&e.settledDamage===30&&e.hpLoss===0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge);const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4995/snapshot.json'),x=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[20606,10993,10996,20607,31143],enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[29463,20276,20565,11141,38550]});x.moveDefinitions[key(29463)].operations=x.moveDefinitions[key(29463)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===816);turn(x,20606,29463);x.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(x,10993,20276);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.reincarnationUsed,false);});

tests.name: 5000/753属性直伤不当作攻击触发虚无，生命魂印回复不受技能禁疗限制且粉伤免疫不妨碍生命回复
tests.assertion: test('5000/753属性直伤不当作攻击触发虚无，生命魂印回复不受技能禁疗限制且粉伤免疫不妨碍生命回复',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/4355.json').snapshot,s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[27925,10250,20065,10628,35797]});s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===1792);turn(s,20606,27925);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.some(e=>e.redCategory==='attribute'&&e.hpLoss>0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.voidCharge,undefined);const x=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(x,0,'技能禁疗',{});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(x,20606,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,3250);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal((x.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='percent').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),0);});

tests.name: 5000/753元素真实入场清回合成功才封下次整招，失败不授，圣洁免异常与弱化
tests.assertion: test('5000/753元素真实入场清回合成功才封下次整招，失败不授，圣洁免异常与弱化',()=>{for(const active of[false,true]){const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0&&active)c.t.effects['免弱']={start:1,end:3};old.run(e,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextSkillInvalid??0,active?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['免弱'],undefined);turn(s,20606,10127);if(active)assert.equal(red(s),0);}const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4995/snapshot.json');for(const move of[20565,38549]){const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[20565,38549,20276,11141,38550]});s.moveDefinitions[key(38549)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(38549)].operations.filter(x=>x.effectId===1447);turn(s,20606,move);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,0);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

tests.name: 5000/753能量先按损失HP一半附粉，生命再回复四分之一且随机两个未满PP无放回，只有一个候选不补抽
tests.assertion: test('5000/753能量先按损失HP一半附粉，生命再回复四分之一且随机两个未满PP无放回，只有一个候选不补抽',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[0].pp[key(25679)]=0;turn(s,20606,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),4000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,3250);const picked=s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen;assert.equal(picked.length,2);assert.equal(new Set(picked.map(x=>x.key)).size,2);assert.ok(picked.every(x=>x.after-x.before===1));const one=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true});turn(one,20606,20309);assert.equal(one.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.length,1);assert.equal(one.fighters[0].pp[key(20606)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===20606).pp);});

tests.name: 5000/753轮回首次敌方行动致命整回保1，完整伤害与HP损失独立，回末精确返回选择后HP/PP/等级，次轮虚无阻挡，耗尽后轮回不再触发
tests.assertion: test('5000/753轮回首次敌方行动致命整回保1，完整伤害与HP损失独立，回末精确返回选择后HP/PP/等级，次轮虚无阻挡，耗尽后轮回不再触发',()=>{const s=make({move:20606,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:500}}),before={hp:s.fighters[0].hp,pp:{...s.fighters[0].pp},stages:{...s.fighters[0].stages}};turn(s,20606,10127);const e=events(s).find(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.ok(e.settledDamage>100);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,99);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,before.hp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].pp,before.pp);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].stages,before.stages);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.reincarnationUsed,true);assert.equal(s.turns[0].remainingHp[0],100);turn(s,20606,10127);assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.savedRound,1);s.fighters[0].hp=100;turn(s,20606,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.finished,true);});

tests.assertion: test('5000全部26真实招各16种子原生魂印与完整已知链，776未知整招明确回滚，各招真实PP消耗和生命随机回复独立核对',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){if(m.id===24319){const x=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(x,m.id,20309),/Q-5000-002/);assert.equal(x.round,1);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);continue;}for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true,seed:seed*987654321,...(m.id===20498?{loadout:[20498,10993,10996,20606,31143],enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]}:{})});turn(s,m.id,m.id===20498?37920:20309);const restored=s.fighters[0].soulState.pony753.lifePP[0].chosen.some(x=>x.key===key(m.id))?1:0,expected=m.id===31141?restored:m.id===20608?m.pp:m.pp-1+restored;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],expected,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}const p=make({move:m.id,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});
